title: CBSE Explanation Schema
description: Detailed multi-step explanation for a question. Every explanation is stored separately and linked by explanation_id.

explanation_id.description: Unique ID of this explanation. Format: QUESTION_ID-EXP

question_id.description: The question this explanation belongs to

media.description: Optional image filename used in this step

final_answer.description: The correct option letter or the numerical value as string

related_concepts.description: Concepts that help understand this question better

common_mistakes.description: Frequent errors students make on this question

hints.description: Optional progressive hints (can be shown one-by-one)

difficulty_note.description: Optional note explaining why this question is medium or hard
